correctness.rationale: For arbitrary positive gap ratio r, beta and delta, an energy/probability inversion of N tensor-product eigenstates forces an integral count difference \((-p,p+q,-q)\), \(p,q>0\), \(r<p/q<r+\delta\), and \(N\ge p+q\); conversely a swap of \(|1\rangle^{\otimes(p+q)}\) with \(|0\rangle^{\otimes p}\otimes|2\rangle^{\otimes q}\) exactly realizes the reversed ordering. For phi gap, successive upper Fibonacci convergents bound the open interval between adjacent Farey fractions with determinant one; positive integral determinants force \(q\ge F_{2k+2}\), while \(p>\varphi q\) forces \(p\ge F_{2k+3}\), and the mediant attains the bound. Binet asymptotics of the exact positive rational approximation errors produce distinct liminf and limsup. All boundary inequalities are strict where needed. Standalone exact-arithmetic finite fraction, occupancy and irrational-breakpoint tests replayed. These checks support but do not replace the infinite proof.
